home.title: Your English. Your opportunities.
home.subtitle: A clear, trustworthy assessment of your English skills. Take the GEST test at an authorised centre and receive a secure, verifiable report.
home.whyTitle: Built for confidence at every step
home.whyText: From registration to secure results, GEST is designed to make your English proficiency journey straightforward.
home.card1Text: Reading, Listening, Writing and Speaking in one coordinated assessment.
home.card2Text: Your four scores and rounded overall score are paired with CEFR reference levels.
home.card3Text: Every approved report can be verified online using a unique form number and security code.
home.ctaTitle: Ready to take the next step?
home.ctaText: Create a candidate account, complete your profile and reserve a seat at a centre.

register.title: Create your candidate account
register.intro: Join GEST to find your test date, manage your registration and access verified score reports.
register.benefit1: Book sessions at an authorised test centre
register.benefit3: Download your secure Test Report Form

booking.title: Available test sessions
booking.intro: Choose a centre and date. Seat availability is updated when candidates book or cancel.
booking.note: Payment is recorded by the test centre; online card payment is not yet available.

verify.title: Verify a GEST result
verify.intro: Confirm the authenticity and current validity of a Test Report Form.
verify.help: Both values are printed on the Test Report Form. Verification requests are rate limited.
verify.invalidText: The supplied form number and security code could not be verified. Please check both values and try again.
